facts.statement: The Dares performed a concert that was credited with setting a Guinness World Record for the first concert held simultaneously in the real world and a virtual space.
facts.quote: Setting a Guinness World Record for "the first concert to take place simultaneously in the real world and a virtual space"

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (The Free Realms theme song is on iTunes)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing that the Free Realms theme song, "It's Your World," performed by The Dares, was available for purchase on iTunes. The post says the song was a Guinness World Record-linked concert performance and was heard in TV commercials and in-game. The post is dated only relative to capture ('3 days, 1 hour ago'), so its exact date is unknown (roughly late June 2009).
